name: The Cultural Landscape of Al-Faw Archaeological Area
description: Al-Faw is an ancient caravan city on the edge of Saudi Arabia's Empty Quarter, about 700 km southwest of Riyadh. Once a capital of the Kingdom of Kinda, it was abandoned around the 5th century CE. Visitors can see houses, markets, temples and wells, along with a sacred mountain, rock carvings and thousands of burial cairns scattered across the valley.
